mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_sessions (session_id, user_id, title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, title, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_sessions WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, session_id, user_id, title, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
